_README.purpose: Competitor-to-Majestic high-visibility apparel cross-reference. A rep enters a competitor part number; the tool returns the three closest Majestic garments as Good / Better / Best.
_README.structure: Two tables, matching the glove dataset. 'majestic' is the pool of Majestic hi-vis products. 'competitors' is keyed by part number and carries its specs plus override fields.
_README.hard_gate: Compare Group is a HARD filter, not a score. A Type R Class 2 upper garment is only ever matched against another Type R Class 2 upper garment — ANSI 107 classes are not interchangeable. Garment Type is the second gate (a vest is not a t-shirt).
_README.matching_logic: Match #1 comes from 'overrideBestMatch' (human-verified). Matches #2 and #3 are scored at runtime against the Majestic pool within the gate, excluding #1.
_README.overrides: Curated #1 pins are NOT stored in this file. This file is regenerated from the source spreadsheets whenever a brand is added, so anything kept here is destroyed on the next rebuild. They live in comparison-overrides.json, which no script writes.
_README.altParts: Size and colour SKUs that resolve to the same style row, so a rep can type any of them.
_README.dataNotes: Where a source sheet was ambiguous the row carries a note rather than a guessed value. Surface these in the UI, do not hide them.
